sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A fitted leather cap, stitched in curved panels to follow the head.

sections.heading: Use & mechanics
sections.text:
Armor value (AV): +1.
Dodge value (DV): +0.
AV protects a struck body location, not the whole body.
Equip slots: Head.

sections.heading: Enhancements
sections.text: Coated against cold: +35 cold resistance while worn, 93 more turns of wear (of 100). It also blunts freezing. Cold still does at least 1 damage per hit until your resistance reaches 100.
